baseline_models.focus_anchor: تُسْقِطَ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا ... تَأْتِىَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ قَبِيلًا
baseline_models.mechanism: Both alternatives abolish distance: the elevated covering must fall as detached pieces onto the speakers, or the divine and angelic parties must arrive in direct confrontation.

activation_trace.role: Downward falling supplies the commanded collapse that converts height into contact.
The high covering supplies the remote upper domain whose separation is to be broken.
Detached pieces make the collapse particulate and locally encounterable rather than merely cosmic.
Arrival supplies the second way of eliminating remoteness.
Face-to-face confrontation gives the requested arrival its inspectable orientation.

changed_reading.before: Two unrelated spectacular demands, one destructive and one visionary.
changed_reading.after: A paired forced-contact test: either the upper world strikes the challengers or its highest parties stand directly before them.

baseline_models.mechanism: The challenge treats the addressee's claim first as suspect speech and then as an assumed guarantee: produce the named principal and angelic agents, with a face-to-face party or surety making the assertion answerable.

activation_trace.role: Speech lacking certainty marks the cited claim as disputed rather than conceded.
Assuming a guarantee converts the disputed claim into liability for its performance.
Bringing or presenting supplies the demanded performance of the alleged guarantee.
Angelic messengers supply the principal's agents to be produced with him.
Surety and undertaking make the final noun echo the challenge's contractual pressure.

changed_reading.before: A taunt asking the speaker to substantiate a prediction.
changed_reading.after: An adversarial demand that disputed speech become an enforceable undertaking by producing its principal and agents.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 17:90-93 the requested proof is routed through a complete spatial circuit: split the lower ground so water rises, drive rivers through openings, force the upper covering down in pieces, then climb upward and deliver a writing downward. The focus ayah is the reversal hinge, not an isolated catastrophe.

activation_trace.role: Wide splitting and emission open the lower boundary for an upward sign.
The lower domain opposite the sky establishes the circuit's first pole.
Water springing from its source gives the first movement its upward material.
Gaps between things route the released water laterally through the garden.
Falling reverses the prior emergence by commanding motion from above to below.
Separated fragments turn the upper boundary itself into routed material.
Ascent on a rising path restarts motion upward after the focus ayah's descent.
Caused delivery downward completes the demanded up-and-down proof circuit.

structural_cues: The ordered sequence is upward emergence (17:90), lateral penetration (17:91), downward collapse (17:92), then ascent and downward delivery (17:93).
The alternating لنا, لك, and علينا phrases make every direction a commanded route toward or for the participants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered motions and their material endpoints; I infer that their order makes 17:92 a sovereignty test over spatial direction. A live alternative is simple rhetorical accumulation of unrelated marvels.

changed_reading.before: A demand for one apocalyptic wonder.
changed_reading.after: The downward hinge in a totalizing test of whether the messenger can command every route between earth, sky, materials, and persons.

context_deltas.mechanism: A delivered recitation, an open challenge to bring an equivalent, and explicit refusal precede the escalating demands. The focus substitutes an unbounded catastrophe or direct divine presence for a sign whose comparable production could actually be attempted.

activation_trace.role: Caused delivery supplies an already-given sign before the later demands.
Bringing or producing makes the earlier test answerable by attempted performance.
An equivalent supplies a bounded comparison standard for that performance.
Refusal supplies the transition from the bounded sign to ever larger conditions.
The disputed-claim image lets the challengers relabel a prior assertion as still unverified.
Face-to-face presence raises verification from comparable production to immediate confrontation.

structural_cues: 17:88 states an equivalence challenge, 17:89 states refusal, and 17:90-93 repeatedly add new conditions.
The focus ayah shifts from signs that mediate a claim to the bodily presence of the claimed authority.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior delivery, bounded comparison, refusal, and escalation; I infer a moving acceptance threshold rather than a neutral search for missing evidence. A live alternative is a sincere preference for sensory proof.

changed_reading.before: One more request in a cumulative case for belief.
changed_reading.after: A threshold-shifting move that abandons an answerable comparison and makes assent depend on catastrophic or unmediated presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The source retains will over revelation, while the addressee is identified as a human messenger; an angelic messenger is then reserved for settled angelic inhabitants. Addressing the human envoy as the one who must bring God and the angels therefore tests an agent by requiring control over his principal and replacement of the audience-matched medium.

activation_trace.role: Will attached to the thing locates control of revelation with the divine source.
Divine communication supplies the delegated medium whose source is not the messenger.
The causative demand makes the addressee responsible for presenting the principal and agents.
Angelic messengers are the higher agents the human envoy is ordered to produce.
Visible-skinned humanity fixes the addressee's creaturely class.
Messenger and message define his delegated office rather than source sovereignty.
Angelic beings and an angelic messenger supply the packet's explicit kind-matched counterfactual.
Sending down marks the angelic messenger as dispatched by a higher source, not self-produced.
The messenger category is preserved even in the angelic counterfactual.

structural_cues: 17:93 answers the demand by pairing بشر with رسول, and 17:95 pairs hypothetical angelic inhabitants with an angelic رسول.
The second-person causatives in 17:92 assign source-level control to the human addressee.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies source-controlled revelation, a human messenger, and a kind-matched angelic counterfactual; I infer that the demand proves the envoy only if he ceases to function as an envoy. A live alternative is that the angels are requested merely as corroborating witnesses.

changed_reading.before: A request that the messenger demonstrate unusually great power.
changed_reading.after: A principal-agent inversion: the envoy must compel his source and higher agents to appear, thereby nullifying the mediated office being tested.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus asks that disputed speech be secured by bringing God and angels face-to-face or as surety. The immediate closure instead declares God sufficient as witness between the two sides: the demanded principal is not an exhibit to be produced but already occupies the evidentiary and adjudicative relation.

activation_trace.role: Guarantee-bearing speech supplies the focus challenge's surety frame.
A guarantor or undertaking makes physical production read as demanded evidentiary security.
Standing for the matter until sufficiency is reached directly answers the demand for added security.
The same named divine principal from the focus becomes the sufficient witness.
Testimony grounded in knowledge supplies the adequate evidentiary role.
The interval between two parties locates testimony inside their dispute.

structural_cues: 17:96 closes the demand sequence by making God the grammatical ground of sufficiency and witness.
The repeated بيني وبينكم formalizes two opposing sides without staging bodily confrontation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies requested surety-like presence and a concluding formula of sufficient witness between parties; I infer that 17:96 reverses the requested evidentiary arrangement. A live alternative is that the closing witness formula is only a general attestation, not a direct answer to قبيلا.

changed_reading.before: God and angels must be physically presented as evidence for the claim.
changed_reading.after: The demand has the forum backward: God already witnesses between claimant and challengers and need not be brought into their chosen witness stand.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the syntax strongly favors a physical sky and fragments. It remains anchored in focus branches for elevated renown, falling from people's eyes, a darkened face, and suspect speech; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary social echo of the literal catastrophe.

activation_trace.role: Elevated good renown supplies a social height that can echo the literal sky.
Falling from people's eyes converts collapse into reputational demotion.
A face or condition darkened by distress supplies the social aftermath of failed standing.
Suspect speech makes the inability to perform threaten the claimant's standing.

changed_reading.before: Only the sky is threatened with collapse.
changed_reading.after: As a contained echo, failure to secure the disputed claim also threatens collapse of the claimant's elevated public standing.

strongest_changes: The 17:90-93 order turns 17:92 into the downward hinge of a demanded earth-sky circulation system.
Prior delivery, bounded comparison, and refusal recast the focus demand as movement of the acceptance threshold.
Human-messenger logic and the sufficient-witness closure reverse both the agency and evidentiary arrangements demanded in the focus.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah binds vertical control, disputed claim and surety, and direct encounter; the surrounding sequence activates all three without forcing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: قبيلا may privilege face-to-face presence or an assembled group more strongly than the surety branch.
The vertical circuit may be deliberate sequence logic or rhetorical accumulation.
The reputational collapse remains a branch-distant secondary echo, not a replacement for the physical reading.
